name: travel-memory-sticker-pack
title_zh: 十二张贴纸一张纸，旅行照变可剪贴画
tagline_zh: 把街拍、宠物、风景照变成低饱和拙朴贴纸页：3张简笔风景+9张真实轮廓剪影。打印即得，剪下就能贴手账，不用再求人抠图。
tagline_en: Turn street, pet, or landscape shots into a low-saturation, clumsy-flat sticker sheet: 3 scenic + 9 true.
desc_en: Turn one or multiple travel, street, landscape, lifestyle, portrait, or pet photos into one portrait 3:4 packaged printable PNG with a sealed header and exactly twelve source-derived die-cut stickers: three simplified scenic stickers and nine true irregular silhouette stickers, rendered in low-saturation deliberately clumsy flat gouache/cut-paper style.
why_zh: 九张不规则剪影直接取自照片主体轮廓，不是通用图形；整体刻意低饱和、扁平拙朴，像手作纸贴，而非AI滤镜。
why_en: Nine irregular silhouettes are traced from real photo subjects, not generic shapes; the deliberate flat, muted style feels.
limit_zh: 只输出竖版3:4单页PNG，需自行打印裁剪；仅支持单张或少量照片合成，复杂多人合影会简化；风格固定为低饱和拙朴。
limit_en: Outputs one portrait 3:4 PNG for self-printing; handles single or few photos only, complex group shots get simplified; fixed low-saturation style.
title_en: Twelve die-cut stickers from your travel photos, one.
